description: M2.3 gold set for public-comment RAG (search_public_comment RPC). 10 queries grounded in real transcript chunks where resolved_role = 'public-speaker'. Targets are matched by (expected_video_id, expected_chunk_idx). expected_sub_chunk_idx is included when the topic evidence sits in a specific sub-chunk. No expected_official_id: the public-comment RPC does not accept an official filter.
notes: Speakers often lack named attribution (source_label = 'Speaker', resolved_name = 'Speaker'), so gold queries reference the topic/claim rather than a named speaker.

queries.text: public commenter about drowning prevention swim lessons for kids in LA
queries.topic_evidence: Calvin Thomas / Dolphin U, drown-proof LA by summer 2028, teach 2028 safer swimmers

queries.text: downtown residents association supporting the CEQA appeal on the El Corazon art park across from City Hall
queries.topic_evidence: Cassie Hoerton, Downtown Residents Association board member, supports the SEIU CEQA appeal on the parcel across from City Hall

queries.text: Boyle Heights warehouse fire burning for six days releasing ammonia and hurting air quality
queries.topic_evidence: Lineage warehouse fire poisoning the East Side for six days, ammonia in the smoke, sore throat and coughing

queries.text: arrested for painting crosswalks and asking the city to declare a traffic violence emergency
queries.topic_evidence: Johnny (People Vision Zero) arrested in December for painting crosswalks, demanding the city declare an emergency for traffic violence

queries.text: resident asking for speed bumps after losing her dog to a hit and run near Venice Boulevard
queries.topic_evidence: Elisa Kim, Westchester Place / Country Club Drive, dog killed by a fleeing driver Aug 8, asks for speed bumps on Venice Blvd

queries.text: history of the LA water conservation ordinance passed in 2009 and lessons for the road map today
queries.topic_evidence: Retiring DWP staffer references the June 2009 water conservation ordinance and the 100-year road map document

queries.text: who is on the hook for fraudulent bond debt at the city and LAUSD, taxpayers or insurers
queries.topic_evidence: Mark Williams asks who repays fraudulent bond debt — defrauded property taxpayers or the city's and LAUSD's insurers — as an election issue

queries.text: former Scientology members asking public works to rename L Ron Hubbard Way back to a normal street name
queries.topic_evidence: Speaker representing former Scientology child labor victims, asking public works to revert L. Ron Hubbard Way to a regular street designation and to stop granting permits

queries.text: army veteran demanding LAPD Rampart accountability after false accusations and rubber bullets at protests
queries.topic_evidence: Monica, District 1 army vet, false police reporting at LAPD Rampart, rubber bullets and tear gas at protests, demands accountability and transparency

queries.text: asking the council to protect renters and pursue social housing so the city doesn't rely on stopgaps
queries.topic_evidence: Public commenter urges support for the plan while pushing further on protecting renters and pursuing social housing
